dataset: V2X-Sim 2.0, prepared vehicle LiDAR inputs, no roadside unit
dataset_tables: Official partition totals and ten (partition, nonempty vehicle inputs) groups; raw point counts rounded to one decimal using M/B suffixes

dataset_table_style.scope: Same partition fill colors in both native dataset tables

result_scope: Original full test split, same epoch-100 student, sharing on versus off; additional test-loss pass uses the same fixed checkpoint

result_plots.placement: On Reproduced Results, below the AP table

excluded_result: November 4 agent-count sweep uses a different cohort and is not mixed with the full-test comparison

iou_explanation.definition: Intersection area divided by union area; thresholds specify the minimum fraction required for a match
iou_explanation.threshold_notation: IoU@0.5 is shorthand for a matching threshold of 0.5 (50% of union area); AP@0.5 is AP evaluated at that IoU threshold
iou_explanation.definition_slide_layout: Centered introduction and imagegen illustration, followed by one centered LaTeX display equation with stacked definition/numeric fractions and a separate centered range note

confidence_example.layout: Three numbered headings across the top, centered softmax formula, native logit/score table beside the worked Box A calculation

qualitative_examples.placement: After Dataset Analysis, before Experiment Setup
qualitative_examples.scope: Recorded single-frame qualitative comparison, separate from the full-test AP results
qualitative_examples.camera_images: Six unmodified original 1600 by 900 RGB images from the matching frame

experiment_setup.placement: After the qualitative detection and camera examples, immediately before Reproduced Results
experiment_setup.presentation: Native hardware/software tables with expanded vertical spacing; model, execution and dataset details retained only in provenance

runtime_scaling.placement: Last content slide of Experiments, after Reproduced Results
runtime_scaling.presentation: Enlarged chart only; introductory line, summary and timing notes omitted
runtime_scaling.scope: Runtime-only model input scaling on the same 30 frames; separate from the original full-test AP comparison
runtime_scaling.input_counts: 1 through 20 model input slots; slots above five repeat the five recorded scans and poses

visible_source_credits.policy: Short AI illustration credits for visible legends; original camera images use a short V2X-Sim 2.0 credit. Detailed factual sources remain in these records and asset provenance
